description: Presidential Secretariate - All the members of the Armed Forces call out with effect from 22.05.2023
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, calling out the armed forces for the maintenance of public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it exercises powers granted by existing legislation (Chapter 40) and creates a legally binding directive. This falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves regulatory frameworks, legal notices, and the implementation of statutory powers.
